fixes.explanation: Not just the poorest families, friend. They fasted and wore sackcloth "…from the greatest of them to the least." (Jonah 3:5) The greatest are in there too, so nobody gets to be the one person in regular clothes. I bet that's a sight, a whole city in the same outfit.

Nope, friend, the disaster doesn't come. "When God saw their actions—that they had turned from their evil ways—He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them." (Jonah 3:10) God sees what they did, and then He relents, in that order. I think that's a big exhale for a city whose king had just said, "Who knows?" (Jonah 3:9)
